question: I have hands but cannot clap. What am I?
What has a face and two hands but no arms or legs?
I am tall when I'm young and short when I'm old. What am I?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
What has keys but can't open locks?
I fly without wings and cry without eyes. What am I?
What can you catch but not throw?
What has to be broken before you can use it?
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
What has one eye but cannot see?
Tick-tock, tick-tock, I go all day! I have hands that never wave and never play. What am I?
I've got a face, and I've got two hands too, but no fingers to hold, and no legs like you! What am I?
I've got teeth, oh so many, but I never bite! I just make your hair look nice and neat and bright! What am I?
I've got a neck but no head to shake, and I hold your water when you're thirsty for a drink to take! What am I?
I've got four legs but I never run around, I just sit there quietly while you munch your food down! What am I?
I've got a mouth but I never say a peep, I just hold your cookies safe while they sleep! What am I?
I've got one little eye but I can't see a thing, yet I help sew your socks with a thread I bring! What am I?
I've got black and white keys, oh what a sight, but I never open a door, day or night! Press me and music comes out, so bright! What am I?
I've got a tail but I'm not a dog, I fly way up high, above the fog! What am I?
I've got two wheels but I'm not a car, pedal me fast and you'll go far! What am I?
I've got a spout like an elephant's trunk, and I make your tea steamy and hot, not junk! What am I?
I've got lots of pages but no story to tell, I show the months and days really well! What am I?
I've got a face but I never grin, yet shopkeepers love it when I jingle and spin! What am I?
I've got arms but I can't give a hug, I just sit and wait for you, all snug! What am I?
I've got a spine but it never hurts, I'm full of stories, pictures, and words! What am I?
I've got a trunk but I'm not an elephant, I carry your clothes, all neat and content! What am I?
I've got a bright light but I'm not the sun, I glow in your room when the day is done! What am I?
I've got bristles but I'm not a hairbrush, I sweep the floor with a swish and a rush! What am I?
I've got a screen but I'm not a movie, you tap on me and I get all groovy! What am I?
I've got a zip like a smiling mouth, I hold your books as you head out south! What am I?
